QUOTE: if no allow-list or auto-approve match exists and an `on_tool_call` callback is registered, `approved` is set to `true` after the callback fires... the deny list is the only thing left that can stop an unlisted call.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that an unlisted tool gets approved and only the deny list can block it, which is the default-allow posture.
